title: PORK CUTLETS AND ANCHOVY SAUCE
instructions: --Broil on a well greased gridiron, over the fire, nicely cut and trimmed cutlets of pork. Place frills on the bones of the cutlets. Serve very hot with Anchovy Sauce.
